title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 15: gentle answers, the tongue of the wise, and the fear of Yahweh.

questions.text: According to Proverbs 15, a gentle answer turns away wrath, but what does a harsh word do?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:1 says a gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

questions.text: Where are Yahweh's eyes, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:3 says Yahweh's eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

questions.text: What is a gentle tongue compared to in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:4 says a gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

questions.text: What does a glad heart do, according to this saying?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:13 says a glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

questions.text: This chapter says a little with the fear of Yahweh is better than what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:16 says better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.

questions.text: What meal does this chapter say is better than a fattened calf with hatred?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:17 says better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

answers.text: A dinner of herbs, where love is

questions.text: What happens to plans where there is no counsel?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:22 says where there is no counsel, plans fail, but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

questions.text: Whose house will Yahweh uproot, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:25 says Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow's borders intact.

questions.text: Whose prayer does Yahweh hear, though he is far from the wicked?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:29 says Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

questions.text: According to the last verse of this chapter, what comes before honor?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:33 says the fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom, and before honor is humility.
